name: Hoshigami
source:
The modern "Star God." He welcomed two people, Aka and Yoru, to a mansion within the sacred precincts.

Although he is Aka's grandmother's older brother, he appears to have stopped aging at the age of twelve, after inheriting the title of "Star God". He has a whimsical and selfish personality. His atmosphere is "alien-like."

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/hoshikuzu.html]official website[/url]]
